name: Nguyen Tieu at Chua Ong
summary: Tết Nguyên tiêu at Chùa Ông, 24 Trần Phú, where people come to worship on the 16th of the first lunar month. Processions, and the monthly lantern night when it falls inside the festival, fill the old town. In 2026 the festival ran from 26 February to 4 March, and the centre waived sightseeing tickets for the named halls on those days.
when: The 16th of the first lunar month; 26 February to 4 March in 2026. Next year’s civil dates: confirm locally.
